{{Quote|I am Jedi Knight Renij Jaa. Thank you for your assistance. It is greatly appreciated. Now if you do not mind, I have some questions for you.|Renij Jaa, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="OB" />}}
'''Renij Jaa''' was an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jaa was placed in command of all Republic forces in the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]] and became based on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Dessin's Dagger]]'' attempted to attach a device to a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] in the Druckenwell [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was subsequently pursued by three Republic [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] assisted the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] with the capture of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and in the aftermath of the incident, Jaa summoned the agents to ''New Dawn'', so that he could debrief them. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the agents learned of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] plot to destroy a Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and warned Jaa of the threat, via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They planted a device aboard a luxury liner. We are still analyzing exactly what its purpose was.|Renij Jaa, on the crew of ''Dessin's Dagger''|<ref name="OB" />}}
An [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Renij Jaa served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Within the Order, he became a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]],<ref name="OB" /> a combat-orientated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization,<ref name="Roleplaying">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> and he eventually constructed his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict that was fought between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], members of the Jedi Order were called up to serve with and lead the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army of the Republic]]. Jaa was appointed as the chief coordinator of Republic forces in the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and became based on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']], a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] installation that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]].<ref name="OB" />

In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Republic forces in the Druckenwell [[Star system/Legends|system]] sighted the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Dessin's Dagger]]'' attempting to attach a device to a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], and three Republic [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] were dispatched to apprehend the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. ''Dessin's Dagger'' attempted to flee the system and was pursued by the three [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and it narrowly avoided a collision with a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was carrying the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who had journeyed to Druckenwell from the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="OB" />

{{RPG|[[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']]}}
The agents helped the Z-95s to immobilize ''Dessin's Dagger'' and in the aftermath of the incident, Jaa planned to file a report on the rogue freighter. He summoned the Heroes of Cularin to ''New Dawn'' so that he could debrief them on their encounter with ''Dessin's Dagger'', and he met with them in one of the station's conference rooms. After thanking them for the role that they had played in the freighter's capture, Jaa took statements from the agents in relation to who they were and what they were doing in the Druckenwell system. Once he had finished speaking to them, the Jedi signaled to a [[Unidentified clone sergeant (New Dawn)|clone trooper sergeant]] to escort the agents back to their ship, and they departed from the station.<ref name="OB" />

A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the Heroes of Cularin learned that a group of Separatist sympathizers were plotting to blow up an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that was docked with the ''New Dawn''. The agents stowed away on the [[First Light (freighter)|''First Light'']], a freighter that the conspirators were traveling aboard, and contacted Jaa via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], to warn him about the Separatists' plan. While he was skeptical of the agents' claims, he agreed to place all Republic ships in the system on alert and he ordered a freeze on the replenishment ships' stores in the system. The agents eventually seized control of the ''First Light'' and thwarted the plot, and Jaa subsequently thanked them for their efforts.<ref name="OB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They appear more like independent operators. The fact they were willing to fight to the death does not look good. Whatever they had planned was bad. Very bad.|Renij Jaa, on the crew of ''Dessin's Dagger''|<ref name="OB" />}}
Renji Jaa wanted to play an active role in defending the Republic from the forces of the Separatists and was irritated by his assignment to monitor war materiel in the Druckenwell system, far behind the front lines of the Clone Wars. While he maintained a professional demeanor, he struggled to master his frustration, and his ill-mood made him abrupt and to the point. During his inquiries into the actions of ''Dessin's Dagger'', Jaa became concerned by the willingness of the freighter's crew to fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]], and he suspected that they had planned to carry out something that would be bad for the Republic. Jaa was [[Language/Legends|bilingual]] and he could speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Iktotchese/Legends|Iktotchese]].<ref name="OB" />

==Powers and abilities==
Renij Jaa was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|affect the minds]] of others, to [[Force healing/Legends|heal himself]], to [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]], to [[Force speed/Legends|run fast]], and to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things. In addition, he was proficient in the use of the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[battlemind]] and [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]].<ref name="OB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I am Jedi Knight Renij Jaa. You were witness to the events involving our fighters and a rogue freighter. I have some questions for you.|Renij Jaa, to the Heroes of Cularin, if the player characters did not assist the Republic starfighters that were pursuing ''Dessin's Dagger''|<ref name="OB" />}}
Jaa was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]] for [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']], a [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy|''Looking In'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the scenario, the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the Heroes of Cularin and have the option of aiding the Republic Z-95 Headhunters that pursue ''Dessin's Dagger''. If the players chose to do so, then when they first encounter Jaa on ''New Dawn'' he begins his conversation with them by thanking the agents for their assistance. If any of the player characters are Jedi, Jaa then inquires as to where they completed their [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] and who their [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] are, and he wonders to himself why the player character Jedi get to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] while he is assigned to remain in the Druckenwell system. If the player characters are helpful to Jaa when he questions them, he informs them that the Republic is willing to pay to repair any damage that they sustained to their starship during their engagement with ''Dessin's Dagger''. However, if any of the players attempt to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into ''New Dawn''{{'s}} [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network, Jaa warns them that doing so would be a [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] act that would be punishable by [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="OB" />

When the player characters learn that the Separatist sympathizers are planning to attack the ''Acclamator''-class [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]], the players have the option of attempting to send a warning to Jaa, and Jedi player characters are able to reach him via comlink. Non-Jedi player characters are only able to speak to Jaa after contacting the Druckenwell system's Republic forces and bluffing them into putting the agents into communications with Jaa. If the players then manage to get through to him, Jaa is exasperated by their efforts, but he agrees to listen to their warning.<ref name="OB" />
